sampling: Unique originals; 50 assigned to each HOL stratum, preserving all overlapping labels. Stratification cycles over source/depth/original-gold buckets among eligible cases; not representative of ineligible cases.
protocol: Canonical factual renderings; regenerate all three variants independently; same rules, one fact changed, no gold or intervention label sent. Source decisions translated into fixed decision codes.

metrics.CRS: P(counterfactual answer = counterfactual gold | original answer = original gold), denominator reported; also report unconditional both-correct rate.
metrics.flip_rate: P(model decisive answer differs from original answer); not sufficient for correctness.
metrics.false_flip_rate: P(model invariant answer differs from original answer).
metrics.selectivity_gap: Decisive flip rate minus invariant false-flip rate.

supersedes: DeepSeek requests retired due to rate limiting; GLM completed responses reused unchanged.
glm_routing_note: User authorized provider switch; reuse successful responses, new round of up to 4 attempts for unresolved GLM requests. Provider defaults and quantization may differ; actual provider retained in full_response.
